svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Logos of the languages, frameworks, databases, cloud platforms and tools I use. Languages: C++, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3; Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap; Backend & Data: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis; Cloud: AWS, Vercel, Netlify, Firebase, Render; Devops & Tools: Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD, Git, GitHub, VS Code; Ai-Native Editors: Cursor, Antigravity
